title: The Great Commission
definition: The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations by going, baptizing, and teaching obedience to His Word.
summary: The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations by going, baptizing, and teaching obedience to Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His Church with all authority and promises His presence to the end of the age.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Great Commission is Christ's command to make disciples of all nations. Scripture ties this mission to going, baptizing, and teaching people to obey everything Jesus commanded.

The commission is broader than decisions, events, or publicity. Its goal is disciples who confess Christ, enter the visible people of God, and learn obedience to Him.

Jesus gives this command with all authority in heaven and on earth. The church goes because the risen King sends and remains with His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches can confuse activity with disciple-making. The Great Commission keeps evangelism, baptism, teaching, obedience, and mission joined together under Christ's authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Make disciples where God has placed you and support disciple-making beyond your reach. Share the Gospel, help people follow Jesus, and measure ministry by faithfulness to His command.
